review_mode: Saved JSON/hash/size/digest/arithmetic/source review only, no candidate import or optimizer/model rerun.

chronology.order: holder launch < bound READY verified <= contender launch < contender reap <= own holder SIGKILL/reap <= recover launch < recover reap

lease.scope: Training create/load and delivery contention refused before factory/provider; same-instance thread prepare/save/close refused; pending close refused without release; recovery excludes delivery until close, known factory failure releases lock, subsequent metadata delivery constructor succeeds. Transient behavior is saved assertions plus source evidence, not separate syscall trace.

state.pending_not_recovered: Explicit committed snapshot has no pending token or second update. Discarded candidate retained separately in READY; not automatically recomputed.

work.evidence: Two separate candidate work receipts each one 50-parameter Adam update; allocation/random count follows audited constructor/restore source paths, not independent global instrumentation. Recovery callback/factory counters zero.

cost.scope: Complete wait4 includes discarded/killed work and supervisor tail. Do not add workers/candidate CPU again. Inner evolving stdout inventory superseded by final outer inventory. Source/review/history extra; RSS not concurrent sum.

limits: Known tiny synthetic local training only, no scientific benefit or production admission.
Explicit chosen trusted checkpoint, not root latest-head or cross-snapshot token ledger. Uncommitted token can be absent in restored older checkpoint; external callback effects not exactly-once.
Cooperating stable trusted local root only; no hostile API bypass prevention, distributed locking, owner authority, powerloss/directory-fsync or inherited-FD lifetime guarantee.
All abort/BaseException/callback/crash timings not newly qualified; original platform/science/data holds and previous provenance correction unchanged.
